Definition: middle voice from G1537 and G639; to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond:--(in) despair.
BiblicalUsage: exaporéomai is a plain word for (in) despair. In 2 Corinthians 1:8, the text says "insomuch that we despaired even of life."
TheologicalSignificance: I read exaporéomai plainly — it means despair, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
